summary: The inspected alternate mapper is controlled by scrub clock state. A source/context rate mismatch alone does not select it. Ordinary direct reading remains possible with different rates under its explicit context gates.

claims.claim: For a non-null channel+0x14c8 and sufficient signed channel capacity, context+0xa8==0 selects the ordinary reader without evaluating the channel override. With context active, nonzero byte(owner+0x258+0x2ec) also selects ordinary. Ordinary additionally requires channel+0x1608==0 and reader success. No source/context rate equality comparison participates.
claims.application: An explicit inactive-scrub/ordinary context may use the ordinary direct-reader machinery with separate source and timeline rates. This does not infer those runtime conditions from CPR bytes.

claims.status: closed concrete default, live-provider boundary retained
claims.claim: Original DefaultProvider<TScrubClockCore,TScrubClockProvider> factory lazily allocates 696 zeroed bytes and constructs the typed provider. Its core initializes +0xa8 to zero, speed +0xc0 to 1.0f; its embedded +0x120 object is TScrubCalculator. A control method activates +0xa8 from supplied speed exceeding exact magnitude threshold 0x3f50624dd2f1a9fc, updates speed/generation/position, and does not compare file/project rates.
limits: The concrete default factory is bound. Full live owner+0x658 subscription/registry replacement and all control callers are not closed. An inactive state is an explicit interpretation context, not proof every hosted channel is inactive.

claims.status: closed state/consumer discrimination; no complete renderer candidate
claims.claim: Alternate channel+0x1a58 state is keyed by provider generation, contains start/end coordinates and current/previous Float32 speeds, and is updated by TScrubCalculator ramp/integral methods. The mapper obtains interpolation objects from global selection: default quadratic Float32 or spline Float32. It advances source position using the second Float32 returned by coefficient slot+0x38, then floors the resulting coordinate. This is transport-speed/ramp mapping, not evidence of ordinary sample-rate conformance.
decompiler_corrections: Initial generation position at +0xb8 is converted from signed64 to Double, not consumed as stored Double.
Mapper uses FCVTMS floor, not truncation.
Coefficient method returns s0 and s1; mapper source increment consumes s1. It is not the prior interpolated sample amplitude.
limits: No complete scrub sample equivalence claim, all ramp settings/host configuration unbound.
Global interpolation choice, ring lifetime and arbitrary provider replacement remain runtime inputs.

claims.status: closed field writers, product label withheld
claims.claim: Two concrete setters store caller Boolean into owner+0x258+0x2ec; a refresh path copies parameter-object state into that byte. These inspected writers contain no source/project rate comparison. The byte is treated only as a channel Boolean override.
limits: No UI label or complete parameter provenance is inferred. Inactive context short-circuits this byte in the selector.

required: Concrete inspected channel reader/descriptor/accessor relationships from prior studies.
Non-null channel owner and supported requested channel count.
Explicit inactive scrub context (+0xa8==0), or separately established active-context channel override.
Ordinary-block flag +0x1608==0 and successful ordinary reader.
Complete source interval capacity for the requested direct read; rate mismatch must not be silently repaired with resampling or padding.
not_established: Whole-project native playback, routing, automation or arbitrary hosted providers.
Source-file rate equals builder, reader, device or project rate.
CPR metadata sets these runtime channel control flags.
Every prepared or cached stream is the original AudioCluster.

evidence_scope: Original bytes, dispatch/RTTI and isolated REA are static evidence.
24 analytical selector controls validate the documented Boolean model, not target execution.
Nearby discovery functions are retained for custody without promoting every instruction to a closed claim.
Vendor documentation, if used by application integration, is a separate evidence class and not incorporated as a native proof here.
next_application_boundary: Explicit project-clock ordinary direct-reader mode may preserve source accessor rate and raw frame identity, with complete-capacity rejection. Predicted speed/pitch effects need independent application tests; this study does not substitute a converter.
